source.title: Kangxi radical positional variants: targeted alternative definitions and historical-origin audit

96-1.learnerNote: This jade component belongs to 玉 (yù). It resembles 王 (wáng, king), but has a different historical origin and meaning.
96-1.readingNote: yù is the parent radical’s dictionary reading, not an independent lexical reading assigned to ⺩.
96-1.usageConstraint: Use this meaning for 玉-derived jade components; a visually similar 王 shape does not by itself prove jade origin.

lookAlike.note: This lexical reading and meaning belong to the independent character 王 and must not replace the jade-component identity when the radical #96 variant is selected.

guidance.whenSelectedAsRadicalVariant: Show jade-component identity and meaning from 玉 (yù), and optionally explain the look-alike independent character 王 (wáng).
guidance.doNotOverwriteCharacterEntry: 王 (wáng) retains its ordinary dictionary meaning and reading in the Characters view.
guidance.doNotRewriteSourceGlyph: Keep the recorded form 王 and alias ⺩ unchanged to preserve source mappings.
guidance.exampleCurationNote: Prefer unambiguous jade-component examples such as 珠 (zhū) over 玉 (yù) itself in a form-specific “In a character” list; do not alter automated corpus results without checking their decomposition provenance.
